definitions.explanation: an egg laid by a chicken, especially as used in cooking or as a food product

examples.japanese: {鶏卵|けいらん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price of eggs is going up.

examples.japanese: {鶏卵|けいらん}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{給食|きゅうしょく}→給食：13800_kyuushoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Children with egg allergies need to be careful with school lunches.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{有数|ゆうすう}→有数：13006_yuusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鶏卵|けいらん}{消費国|しょうひこく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{一人当|ひとりあ}たり⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧300⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消費|しょうひ}する→消費する：25230_shouhisuru⟧。
examples.english: Japan is one of the world's leading egg-consuming countries, with each person consuming about 300 eggs per year.

notes:
Composed of {鶏|けい} (chicken) + {卵|らん} (egg). A formal or technical term for chicken eggs, used in food industry, allergy labeling, agricultural statistics, and scientific contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ alone usually refers to chicken eggs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鶏卵|けいらん}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: egg allergy
- {鶏卵|けいらん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧: egg production
- {鶏卵|けいらん}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: egg prices
- {鶏卵|けいらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧: uses eggs (food labeling)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: egg — the everyday word; usually means chicken egg unless specified otherwise
- ⟦{生卵|なまたまご}→生卵：19011_namatamago⟧: raw egg — an uncooked egg, commonly eaten in Japan
- {玉子|たまご}: egg (as a cooked ingredient) — often used for dishes like {玉子焼|たまごや}き
- うずら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: quail egg
